note: The colony's planet info mode (re/screens/colony.md §12) on an own planet (quick-1.sav, planet 42): hot-spot 4 left-clicked (on), tax + (0x18), the tax menu pressed, the pointer moved to item 3 and released, auto-build ALL (0x1a), priority − (0x1d), a click on the screen (0x20: off).
